voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Pag humihina ang tunog, hindi siya lumalayo. Lumalapit siya.
lines.beat_before: hook: one dim bulb in a wooden barrio house, the child asleep on a banig, the dark gap under the roof

lines.text: Sabi ng lola ko, nangangaso raw siya tuwing pista, habang malakas ang videoke at walang nakakarinig sa mga aso.
lines.beat_before: the barrio street during the fiesta: banderitas, the videoke glow far off, a sari-sari store

lines.text: Nagtali siya ng bawang sa bintana. Nagbuhos siya ng asin sa pasimano.
lines.beat_before: Lola's hands tie garlic at the jalousie window; salt poured along the sill

lines.text: Tapos narinig namin. Tik-tik. Malakas. "Malayo pa," sabi niya.
lines.beat_before: the roofs from the street, the moon, coconut trees; the TIK-TIK far away
inside: the bulb sways; Lola looks up
the camera tilts up to the gap between the wall and the roof

lines.text: Tumigil ang videoke, sa gitna ng kanta.
lines.beat_before: outside: the videoke screen goes dark mid-song; the dogs stop

lines.text: Hindi gumalaw si Lola. Nakatingin siya sa bubong.
lines.beat_before: inside, behind Lola: she stares at the roof

lines.text: Kinaumagahan, nakakalat ang asin sa pasimano.
lines.beat_before: held silence; a long tongue lowers from the roof gap; the bulb flickers; the face in the gap (stinger in silence); black; a rooster
dawn: the sill; the salt scattered inward, across the floor
